column1: # Self-test cases of the security flags, for scripts/interop.sh. They run for
# every pairing of adapters that declare the feature secureAuthentication,
# each case against a freshly started server.
#   1  exit    expected exit code of the client
#   2  summary as in tests/cases.tsv, followed by "secured=" and the field of
# scripts/lib.sh (make_identities) makes the key material; it is mounted at
# Both stations trust the authority; MAC HMAC-SHA-256 (4) without encryption.
# Encryption: AEAD-AES-256-GCM (11), and other association identities.

column2: ok=true error=- conf=7 term=false asdus=C_TS_TA_1/7 secured=true

column1: # Role-based access control: a viewer may interrogate, not command.

column2: ok=false error=negative-confirmation conf=17n term=false asdus=C_SC_NA_1/17 secured=true

column1: # A station nobody trusts gets no association.

column2: ok=false error=security-failed conf= term=false asdus= secured=false

column1: # A controlling station that does not trust the station does not associate.

column2: ok=false error=security-failed conf= term=false asdus= secured=false

column1: # A secure station answers nothing that is not secured.

column2: ok=false error=timeout conf= term=false asdus= secured=null
